good_thing: (Lansing, Illinois): The Patti Leach Youth Center has reopened after a year-long renovation. The refreshed after-school space includes a game room, computer lab, mentoring, art club, and activities, with annual membership costing $35. A familiar neighborhood place is ready for young people again.
current_or_history: On September 9, 1947, engineers working on Harvard’s Mark II computer found a moth caught between relay contacts. They taped it into the logbook and recorded the first actual case of a computer “bug” being found.
tiny_fact: Octopuses and other cephalopods have three hearts. Two send oxygen-poor blood to the gills, while the third pumps oxygenated blood around the body, using copper-based hemocyanin that makes it blue.
thought: A small reopening can be a quiet reminder that useful, welcoming things can return.
